relevance.title: Are your opportunities still open?
relevance.text: Tick the opportunities you are still recruiting for and press “Confirm”. No need to sign in.

relevance.invalid: The link is outdated or invalid. Sign in and open “My opportunities”.

emailChange.title: Change email
emailChange.text: You currently sign in with {{email}}. Enter a new address — we will send a link there. The email changes only after you open it.
emailChange.vkHint: You sign in with VK, so no password is needed — a recent sign-in is enough.
emailChange.sent: We sent an email to {{email}}. Open the link within 24 hours — after that, sign in with the new email. No email? Check your spam folder.
emailChange.pending: Awaiting confirmation: {{email}} — the link is valid until {{date}}

emailChange.missing: The link has no code. Open the full link from the email.

confirm.title: Confirm your new email
confirm.text: Press the button to change your account email. After that you will need to sign in again on all devices — with the new email and your current password.
confirm.doneText: You now sign in with {{email}} and your current password.

revert.title: Restore your previous email
revert.text: If someone else changed the email of your account, press the button: we will restore your previous address and sign out all sessions. Your password will be reset too — set a new one.
revert.doneText: You sign in with {{email}} again. All sessions are closed and your password is reset — set a new one via “Forgot password”.

referral.title: Invite a friend
referral.intro: Share your link with friends. When a friend signs up with it and confirms their email, you get the “Recommendation Wizard” badge.
referral.shareText: Volunteer trips in Russia and around the world — join Goodsurfing
referral.invited: Friends who signed up with your link: {{count}}
referral.none: No one has signed up with your link yet
referral.badge: Your first friend earns you the “Recommendation Wizard” badge.
referral.badgeDone: The “Recommendation Wizard” badge will appear in your profile within a day.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.intro: Choose what to be notified about and where. New applications and volunteers' messages are best received in a messenger — you reply faster, and volunteers choose hosts who reply quickly.
notifications.connectHint: The Goodsurfing bot will open — press “Start” there. This page updates by itself.

hints.new_application: Right away: who, which opportunity, dates and the start of the message
hints.new_message: After 10 minutes if you haven't read it; at most once an hour per conversation
hints.host_reply: After 10 minutes if you haven't read it; at most once an hour per conversation
hints.application_status: Right away when your application is accepted or declined

notifications.service: Service messages — email confirmation, password reset, payment, membership ending, opportunity relevance — always come, and to Telegram if it's connected.
notifications.quiet: At night, 23:00–08:00 Moscow time, messenger notifications come silently.
notifications.banner: Get applications in Telegram — reply faster
notifications.introVolunteer: Choose what to be notified about and where. In Telegram you'll see the host's reply right away and can agree on the trip quickly.
